capabilities: Visualize the vault as an interactive 3D galaxy with nebulae, black holes, and a real night-sky background
Time-travel through the vault's growth note by note at adjustable speed
Navigate via search with fly-to, focus mode, hover previews, a minimap, and shortest-path routes between notes
Draw tags as constellations by typing #tag in the search
Capture PNG photos and WebM videos, including a one-click time travel timelapse
extras: Desktop only (needs WebGL); mobile not supported. Not yet in the community plugin list and must be installed manually. Developed and tested on Windows only. Makes no network requests; view state is stored in local storage, settings in data.json. Built with AI assistance (Claude by Anthropic) directed by a human author. Relies on three.js, d3-force-3d, and d3-celestial under MIT/BSD licenses.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is a flat, static visualization, so users cannot explore their vault as an immersive 3D space or watch how it grew over time.
summary: 3D galaxy-style graph view where notes are stars and links are comet paths, with time travel, tag constellations, routes, and photo/video capture.
